description: Source code for a Radio Unit (RU) emulator handling OFH (Open Fronthaul) messages, including configuration, packet processing, and statistics reporting.

classes.name: ru_emulator
classes.description: Class representing a RU emulator handling OFH message reception, processing, and response generation.

methods.name: on_new_frame
methods.description: Handles new incoming frame, dispatching processing task.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the transceiver to begin receiving OFH messages.

methods.name: print_statistics
methods.description: Prints current statistics of the RU emulator.

methods.name: get_ota_notifiers
methods.description: Returns list of OTA symbol boundary notifiers for synchronization.

methods.name: process_new_frame
methods.description: Decodes and processes received OFH message, including validation and response generation.

methods.name: get_window_checker
methods.description: Selects appropriate window checker based on message direction and type.

methods.name: get_sequence_id_checker
methods.description: Selects sequence ID checker based on message direction and type.

methods.name: is_ul_uplane_request
methods.description: Checks if message is an uplink user-plane request.

methods.name: is_prach_uplane_request
methods.description: Checks if message is a PRACH uplink request.

methods.name: print_seq_id_err
methods.description: Generates string of sequence ID error statistics for given eAxC list.

methods.name: update_seq_id_statistics
methods.description: Updates sequence ID statistics based on received message.

methods.name: generate_ul_uplane_messages
methods.description: Generates and sends uplink user-plane messages based on received control plane message.

methods.name: generate_prach_uplane_messages
methods.description: Generates and sends PRACH user-plane messages based on received control plane message.

methods.name: validate_rx_ofh_params
methods.description: Validates decoded OFH message parameters for correctness.

methods.name: set_runtime_header_params
methods.description: Sets timestamp and sequence ID in message header.
